items.consequence: Query parityFields require query-response, the complete owner-admitted GraphQueryResponseV1, preserved by the JSON and agent renderers. The JSON parity reference is CommandEnvelope major 3, which has additionalProperties:false and no field for the response. Under the required-delivery law (workflows lines 995-1005), a missing required parity field is operational-failed DELIVERY.REQUIRED_FAILED. So no conforming JSON/agent rendering of any query command can both satisfy the envelope schema and deliver its required parity field.

items.disposition: real-design-gap; the source reference acceptance exposes a missing validator (owner model contradicts normative prose)
items.consequence: workflows §3: unknown roots, incomplete enumeration, disabled evaluation and exhausted budgets do not establish a negative result. PivotPresence.E4 is a non-nullable boolean, and IndeterminateReason has no member for unknown current absence. The owner comparison sets E4 = bool(matched hit) with no absence proof (source38 workflow_projection_model.v3.py line 2557 in compare_admitted_v3 and line 659 in _derive_or_admit_presence). It copies E4 into unchanged pivots, so a baseline fingerprint whose current rule cannot prove absence is published as CODE-FIXED. For gating rules the comparison verdict still becomes indeterminate through ruleDeficiencies. For non-gating rules a false CODE-FIXED entry is published. No gate flip was found in this analysis.

items.proposedRemedy: Apply the pivot absence-knowledge law to the current side: E4 is false only when rule_can_prove_absence and path_absence_claim_allowed hold for that fingerprint's rule; otherwise classify INDETERMINATE with a new IndeterminateReason (e.g. current-absence-unknown). Keep E4 boolean, or make it nullable consistently with E0-E3; root decides the comparison-result schema consequence. Separately, consider distinguishing a bound-but-unknown pivot from pivot-reevaluation-unavailable. Add controls: unknown-current-absence is never CODE-FIXED; a known CODE-NET-NEW fail still dominates.

items.confirmedSeverity: MUST-class identity determinism, bounded to unmatched symbol findings with co-occurring correspondence conditions
items.consequence: composition §4 lists the correspondence failure conditions unordered. §9.5 lists one deficiency row per condition. §9.7 takes 'the correspondence cause of §9.5' (singular). The owner reference evaluates in order (projection-unavailable, then population-incomplete, then signature-ambiguous) and emits exactly one correspondence deficiency and that reason. Conditions can co-occur (empty tokens plus incomplete population; incomplete population plus shared signature). Readers that emit every applicable row, or choose another precedence, mint different ruleResult deficiency Csets (proof3/seal3/run3) and possibly different finding3 reasons. Their Runs then refuse complete replay on the other host.
